top_signals.title: Japan likely sold Treasurys to fund record yen intervention
top_signals.summary: Tokyo's holdings of foreign securities fell by $87.8 billion at the end of August from a month earlier, close to the scale of the recent intervention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bathla Group Faces Funding Talks as $2.5 Billion Debt Crisis Deepens
top_signals.summary: Bathla Group, the insolvent Australian property developer that’s shaken the nation’s real estate and private credit market, secured stopgap funding that will help it stay afloat for now even as its broader debt crisis still looms.

top_signals.title: Sanctioned ICC head Akane calls court the last bastion of rule of law
top_signals.summary: The U.S. government imposed sanctions on ICC President Tomoko Akane and an ICC senior trial lawyer last month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
